ux_intent: Validate that the TV home screen organises content into D-pad-navigable rows, focus indicators are large and visible at 10-foot viewing distance, and the layout works at TV resolution with appropriate text sizing.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a TV home screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: Android TV, 1920x1080 base frame.
No top app bar. Full-screen layout. A persistent side navigation panel on the left: collapsed by default at 60dp wide (icons only), expands to 240dp on focus (icons + labels). Icons: Home (active, primary #6366F1), Browse, Search, Settings — each 32dp, white when inactive.

Layout:
- Main content area (right of side nav): vertical scroll of content rows.
- Each row:
  - Row header: category name (Title Small 20sp #FFFFFF weight 600), left-aligned, 32px from the left edge of the content area.
  - Horizontal-scroll row of title cards: each 280x380dp. Cover image fills the card, radius 12px. Title overlaid at the bottom on a gradient (black 50 % opacity), Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF.
  - 32px vertical gap between rows.
- Visible rows: Featured, Continue Watching, New Releases, Popular.
- Focus ring: 4px solid primary #6366F1 around the focused card. Focused card scales up 1.05×.

States:
- Default: first card in Featured row is focused. Focus ring and scale-up visible.
- Row navigation: D-pad up/down moves focus between rows. Focus lands on the first card of the target row.
- Card navigation: D-pad left/right moves focus within the current row.
- Side nav focused: icons are visible; if D-pad select is pressed, the panel expands to show labels.

Behavior:
- D-pad right/left → move focus within the row.
- D-pad down/up → move focus to the next/previous row.
- D-pad select on a card → navigate to TV Playback.
- D-pad left when on the first card in a row → move focus to the side nav.
- D-pad select on a side nav item → navigate to that section.

Style:
- Dark theme. Background #0F0F1A. Card radius 12px. Text #FFFFFF. Side nav active icon primary #6366F1. Focus ring 4px primary. Auto layout.
- All text ≥ 18sp for 10-foot readability.

First step: default state with four content rows visible, the first card in Featured focused (ring + scale), and the side nav in its collapsed state.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the TV home screen is displayed
When the user uses the D-pad to navigate between cards and rows
Then focus moves predictably and the 4px primary ring is visible on the currently focused element at all times

Given the user presses D-pad select on a content card
When the action registers
Then the screen navigates to the TV Playback screen

Given focus is on the leftmost card in a row and D-pad left is pressed
When focus moves
Then the side nav receives focus and its icons are visible
manual_validation_checklist: Verify the focus ring is 4px solid primary and visible on every card position
Confirm all text is ≥ 18sp: row headers (20sp), card titles (18sp), side nav labels
Measure title cards: 280x380dp each. Confirm horizontal scrollability within each row
Check side nav: collapsed 60dp (icons only) vs expanded 240dp (icons + labels). Active icon is primary #6366F1
Verify the 1.05× scale-up on the focused card does not cause overlap with adjacent cards
Confirm 32px vertical gap between rows and 32px left margin on row headers
